gloss: to keep heading one way; to go on (worsening, falling)

definitions.gloss: to keep heading in one direction; to continue steadily (worsening, increasing, declining)
definitions.explanation: Used after a noun of change + の to say that a trend keeps going the same way without letting up. Most often of bad trends, such as worsening or decline. Formal; common in news and reports.

examples.japanese: ⟦{病状|びょうじょう}→病状：21011_byoujou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{悪化|あっか}→悪化：11077_akka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一途|いっと}をたどった。
⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人口|じんこう}→人口：01618_jinkou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{減少|げんしょう}→減少：02719_genshou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一途|いっと}をたどって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The town's population keeps on falling.

examples.japanese: ⟦{両国|りょうこく}→両国：10010_ryoukoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、⟦{悪化|あっか}→悪化：11077_akka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一途|いっと}をたどる⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧だった。
examples.english: After the incident, relations between the two countries only kept getting worse.

notes:
{一途|いっと} means "one road" or "one course", and たどる means to follow a path. The pattern is almost always [noun] + ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + {一途|いっと}をたどる.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{悪化|あっか}→悪化：11077_akka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一途|いっと}をたどる: to keep getting worse
- ⟦{減少|げんしょう}→減少：02719_genshou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一途|いっと}をたどる: to keep decreasing
- ⟦{増加|ぞうか}→増加：03329_zouka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一途|いっと}をたどる: to keep increasing
- ⟦{衰退|すいたい}→衰退：07428_suitai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一途|いっと}をたどる: to be in steady decline

WATCH OUT:
{一途|いっと} here is read いっ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧. The same kanji read いちず is a different word, ⟦{一途|いちず}→一途：18242_ichizu⟧ "single-minded, wholehearted" (⟦{一途|いちず}→一途：18242_ichizu⟧な⟦{恋|こい}→恋：02208_koi⟧, a devoted love). たどる is sometimes written ⟦{辿|たど}る→辿る：10366_tadoru⟧.
